{"reason":"Add a high-confidence guard to the existing conjunction. V1’s 0.714 false-arbitration rate (20/28) dominates fitness despite recall 1.0; six of eight shown false rows have confidence below 0.70. This guard removes those rows while preserving v1’s magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon logic.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
